name: Muse
source:
Dark elf warrior. 
She is always there when she opens the door to battle, and her name is known to other races.

She is a rare type who uses a large sword, and she has a rough personality that doesn't care about details. 
She is a masculine older sister, and has the trust of her subordinates and those around her. 
She just doesn't get along with the polite knights because she has a bad mouth. 

She is also docile with her sexual desires, quenching the heat on her body with her captive humans after completing her battle.
